preservation_requirements: Preserve all v0.08 frozen artifacts, raw evaluation evidence, defects, regressions, scorecard, and promotion decision even if runtime use rolls back to v0.07.
Do not rewrite v0.08 events or ledgers to make rollback appear as non-occurrence.
rollback_action: Use sealed v0.07 release behavior as promoted parent while retaining v0.08 as historical experimental evidence and opening a governed corrective candidate.
trigger_conditions: Any mandatory v0.08 gate later proves falsely recorded or unreproducible.
Any frozen v0.08 artifact hash mismatch is discovered.
Any critical active regression fails in the sealed deliverable.
Extracted-package verification fails or shipping manifest is stale/incomplete.
